required.rationale: WFC-004/DECISION 1. Six relations named by live code (vendors, org_vendors, vendor_compliance_documents, org_contracts, contract_signature_envelopes, vendor_aliases) have zero `create table` anywhere in this repository, and seven reader sites degrade on them — five of them rendering a bare `null` that CP-098 calls out as the hazard the Workforce Command Center exists to prevent. This migration creates the canonical vendor identity, `public.vendor_entities`, plus `public.vendor_entity_aliases` as a real target for VendorMergePlan.aliasesToRetain. It is deliberately NOT named `vendors` and NOT named `org_vendors`, on an argument proven by execution rather than by preference: the live `app/api/admin/vendors/route.ts:21` select raises SQLSTATE 42703 against the archived VEND-102 shape, 42703 is not the 42P01 the route branches on at :31, and the message contains 'does not exist' but not the substring 'relation' that the outer catch tests at :56 — so creating `vendors` here would convert the one CP-098-correct reader of the seven into a 503 'Vendors unavailable'. The vendors/org_vendors merge question is recorded as UNRESOLVED with the single catalog query that would settle it, and no relation or view under either name is created, because a view named org_vendors would ratify the merge CP-096 forbids.
required.nextAction: Owned by the database lane, reviewed by security-admin and by the vendor-domain owner. Layer 0 of the manifest is a hard STOP if `to_regclass('public.vendors')` or `to_regclass('public.org_vendors')` is non-null on the target, because that means something else has resolved the merge question and this file's recorded decision is out of date. Apply additively in staging under CP-051, run supabase/tests/wfc004_workforce_departments_contract.sql, then the seven labelled probes. EXPECTED AND CORRECT: an organization administrator reads ZERO vendor rows after this apply, because no role matrix row carries vendor.view — that is a fail-closed provisioning gap owned by WFC-003 under CP-102, and the operator must NOT widen the matrix to make the probe non-zero, because any org_role_permissions write invalidates every active acting-context session. The CP-016 regeneration that makes lib/database.types.ts declare these two tables follows the apply. Record the staging history disposition here.

required.rationale: WFC-004/CP-094. Closes WFC-003 §2.4 Gap B (`capability_expressed_entity_unsourced`) and §5 items 8, 10, 18 and 21. ADMIN-012 already delivered the CAPABILITY half of CP-094 — `department` is a first-class AdminCapabilityTarget, `grantCoversCapabilityTarget` and `departmentScopeDenial` apply nine fail-closed codes after the SEC-102 union — so the only thing missing was the entity for `managedDepartmentIds` to be sourced from. This migration creates `workforce_departments` (platform-unique id, one organizations.id, internal-or-vendor kind), `workforce_department_managers` (the accountable-manager relation) and `workforce_department_memberships` (primary and secondary), and expresses CP-094 in the database: one accountable manager per department and one active primary membership per (organization, person) are PARTIAL UNIQUE INDEXES, so they hold under concurrency and the harness measures that with two simultaneous sessions plus a drop-the-index control; secondary membership confers no management authority because the one department-scope function reads the manager relation and never the membership relation, and the contract postflight asserts that omission by name and the harness INJECTS the widening edit to prove the check fires. No backfill of departments or memberships happens here, because there is no provable source — the only department-bearing column in the chain is unconstrained free text, and WFC-003 §6.9 requires replacement by explicit link, never by value comparison.
required.nextAction: Owned by the database lane, reviewed by security-admin, verified by QA. Apply additively in staging under CP-051 AFTER DB-013's 20260926150000 and DB-016's 20260926200000, which this schema must not contradict and does not re-seed. Run supabase/tests/wfc004_workforce_departments_contract.sql (expect `WFC-004 workforce departments|t|0`) and then the nine labelled probes, reading AFFECTED ROW COUNTS rather than exit codes: an RLS-filtered write exits 0 having written nothing, which is CP-110's plausible zero arriving through RLS and is routed to WFC-005 as HF-WFC-004-AFFECTED-ROW-COUNT. Preflight STOP conditions: if `authenticated` lacks SELECT on public.organizations or USAGE on schema auth, every policy here denies and the apply's only visible effect is that workforce reads return nothing. The CP-016 regeneration that makes lib/database.types.ts declare these three tables and two views follows the apply. Record the staging history disposition here.

required.rationale: WFC-004/CP-095 and CP-096. Creates the append-only manager-controlled operational status ledger and the explicit link/reconciliation substrate legacy workforce records are reconciled INTO, in the venue_identity_bridges shape (20260823010000:33-43,112-136) with the code column constrained to WFC-003's eleven WORKFORCE_QUARANTINE_CODES. Append-only is enforced by three independent mechanisms so none has to be trusted alone: `revoke all` plus a narrow `grant` for anon, authenticated AND service_role; a SECURITY INVOKER BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger that raises; and a security_invoker view that derives the current value from the history. The harness attacks the property three ways — as the table owner under FORCE RLS, as service_role, and as service_role with the UPDATE privilege restored by hand — and all three are refused. The backfill seeds reviewable rows from provable sources only and creates ZERO departments and ZERO memberships, which the harness MEASURES rather than asserts: CP-096 forbids a destructive replacement and WFC-003 §6.9 forbids replacing a free-text column by value comparison. This is the one WFC-004 migration that writes rows on apply, into two NEW tables only.
required.nextAction: Owned by the database lane, reviewed by security-admin, verified by QA. Apply additively in staging under CP-051, LAST of the three. THE OPERATOR MUST SIZE THE FIRST RUN: the backfill creates one link row and one quarantine row per distinct non-empty trimmed staff_members.department value and per org-less staff_members row, all in one transaction, so a target with 40,000 distinct department values creates 80,000 rows. preflight.rowCountQueries carries the two counts needed to decide whether to raise statement_timeoutMs above the 60000 set here. Run supabase/tests/wfc004_workforce_departments_contract.sql and the nine labelled probes; EXPECTED AND CORRECT that an org administrator sees FEWER reconciliation rows than exist, because rows whose subject has no established organization (staffing_agencies has no tenant column at all) are invisible by design. The CP-016 regeneration that makes lib/database.types.ts declare these three tables and two views follows the apply. Record the staging history disposition here.

required.rationale: HF-DISC-002-NEWSCHEMA-ACTIVE-CHAIN-GAPS items 1 and 2. The five press columns on public.artist_blog_posts (format, subtitle, boilerplate, embargo_until, distribution) are created ONLY by the ARCHIVED supabase/migration-archive/pre-reconciliation-local-only-2026-08-20/20260717220000_press_content_formats.sql, so they are absent from the active chain AND from the generated contract. Live code depends on them: lib/news/feed-service.ts:485-494 selects format and filters .in('format', ['article','blog']), lib/blog/article-publishing.ts reads and writes all five, and lib/press/press-release-access.ts:36 gates a press release on format === 'press_release'. The failure is SILENT in both directions — a select of a column that does not exist returns nothing, so there is no tsc diagnostic (all three consumers reach the table through the un-generic SupabaseClient), no test failure (__tests__/press asserts on source text, not on a result) and no CodeQL alert, and the entire BLOG SECTION of the news feed is empty on every deployed environment. Additive only: five ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, one CHECK constrained to lib/press/formats.ts PRESS_FORMATS and validated in-transaction, one index serving the feed's real query shape, two change-guarded UPDATEs, two comments. No table, row, policy, grant or RLS setting is created, dropped, altered or narrowed.
required.nextAction: Owned by the database lane, reviewed by press. Apply additively in staging under CP-051, one transaction, one file. THE OPERATOR MUST RUN THE LAYER 0 PREFLIGHT FIRST, because two of its items are STOP CONDITIONS rather than curiosities: the current (format, distribution) distribution of existing rows, because step 3b rewrites every '{}' to its format's defaults; and the current policy set on artist_blog_posts, because the policy "Public can view published blog posts" (20260702210503:142-144) is USING (status = 'published' OR auth.uid() = user_id) and therefore already exposes every published row to anon — this file adds boilerplate, the field most likely to hold pre-announcement text, to an ALREADY-PUBLIC surface. It does not widen row visibility, but a reviewer must SEE the read is unchanged rather than assume it. Then run the postflight queries, including the anonymous SELECT that used to 400 and must now return rows. Three press/security decisions are recorded as NOT closed by this file and are routed, not absorbed: embargo_until is ADVISORY (the PDF route labels with it and never compares it to now()), the anonymous read of boilerplate, and press_release_shares, a SIXTH gap of the identical class that this file does not create because DB-019's working set is three literal filenames. The CP-016 regeneration that makes lib/database.types.ts declare these five columns follows the apply. Record the staging history disposition here.

required.rationale: HF-DISC-002-NEWSCHEMA-ACTIVE-CHAIN-GAPS item 3. rg -ln 'user_news_preferences|user_news_subscriptions' supabase/ returns exactly two live consumers and ZERO migrations — not in the 320-file active chain, not in any archive, not in any root-level SQL — and lib/database.types.ts declares neither. No CREATE TABLE for either relation exists anywhere in this repository. This gap is invisible in a way the other four are not: a missing TABLE does not empty a news-feed section, it silently downgrades the RANKING of every section, so a signed-in reader's subscribed topics and sources are simply never applied and the feed still renders and still looks healthy. The column contract is COMPLETE rather than partial, because the consumer is one function with four selected columns, two filters, one maybeSingle() and one Array.isArray per column. user_id is UNIQUE on user_news_preferences because .maybeSingle() returns PGRST116 on a second row, and the post-condition asserts that structurally. subscription_type is CHECK-constrained to the two values the consumer acts on, because any third value would be read and silently discarded — the same silent-empty failure this file exists to close. UNIQUE (user_id, subscription_type, subscription_key) makes subscribing idempotent, without which a duplicate would be invisible at the read (the consumer folds into a Set) and permanent in the table. Authorization is fail-closed and own-rows-only server-side: every USING and WITH CHECK is auth.uid() = user_id, RLS is enabled AND FORCED, anon is granted nothing, and no DELETE policy is added on purpose.
required.nextAction: Owned by the database lane, reviewed by discover. Apply additively in staging under CP-051; the file creates two EMPTY tables so its lock cost does not scale with any data and it is safe in any order relative to every other migration. THE OPERATOR MUST RUN THE POSTFLIGHT AS AT LEAST TWO DISTINCT SIGNED-IN IDENTITIES PLUS ANON, because a single-identity probe cannot distinguish own-rows-only from see-everything: user A reads 1 own preference row and 2 own subscriptions, user B reads 0 rows as a clean zero and NOT an error, user B's INSERT naming user A is rejected, user B's unqualified UPDATE matches 0 rows, and anon's SELECT is a permission error. All of this was measured on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 before authoring, and the post-condition was proven able to fail four ways including an extra USING (true) policy (the CP-104 shape) and RLS enabled but not forced on ONE of the two tables. One decision is recorded as NOT taken: the delete policy. The consumer never deletes, so delete is denied to every caller until the discover lane specifies the semantics. The CP-016 regeneration that makes lib/database.types.ts declare both tables follows the apply. Record the staging history disposition here.

required.rationale: HF-DISC-002-NEWSCHEMA-ACTIVE-CHAIN-GAPS item 2. public.music_tracks is a VIEW whose last definition, 20260711165607_native_music_player_hardening.sql:117-158, projects 34 explicit columns and none of them is a trust column. The four — origin_status, certification_status, certification_level, certification_public_id — are added to the BASE TABLE by 20260910140000_artist_music_trust_columns.sql:12-15, and a base-table column does not appear in a view that already projects an explicit list. lib/news/feed-service.ts:564-596 selects all four off the VIEW, so PostgREST 400s and the entire MUSIC SECTION of the news feed is empty on every deployed environment, with zero diagnostics. The asymmetry that let it survive: app/api/feed/music/route.ts:176 selects the same four from artist_music where they DO exist, while its primary path at :16 reads the view — so the surface had one working read and one 400ing read of identical fields. Uses CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW rather than the chain's own drop-view-cascade plus create idiom: the replace form appends columns without dropping a dependent object, without CASCADE, and is re-runnable, and PostgreSQL itself refuses a replacement that would remove an existing output column (42P13, measured) so the 34 pre-existing columns cannot be silently lost. security_invoker = true is re-applied explicitly and version-guarded, because without it the view would execute as its owner and bypass artist_music's RLS — a column addition would then be a data-disclosure change. CORRECTION TO THE INBOUND RECORD: the handoff states the live projection has 36 columns; it has 34, measured by letting PostgreSQL resolve the SELECT list, so this file's post-condition asserts 38 and names all 34 pre-existing columns individually.
required.nextAction: Owned by the database lane, reviewed by music. Apply additively in staging under CP-051. FIVE Layer 0 items are STOP CONDITIONS, not warnings: the current output column list of music_tracks must be exactly 34 (38 means already applied, more means the replace will fail with 42P13); all four trust columns must exist on public.artist_music; reloptions must already carry security_invoker=true so the operator can see whether it was ever set; authenticated must hold table-level SELECT on public.artist_music, because security_invoker makes the caller need the BASE table grant and its absence is a functional false-denial for every caller; and nothing may depend on the view in a way a replace would disturb. Then run the postflight, including the anonymous SELECT which must return 0 rows and NOT a full catalogue — that is the probe this file can break. INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED ALREADY: npm run check:db008-harness reports 8 PASS and its view-replay scenario resolved music_tracks at 38 output columns with VIEW-ONLY=origin_status,certification_status,certification_level,certification_public_id and contractOnlyColumns=0, so the repository's own view gate replays this file verbatim. ONE PRODUCT DECISION IS RECORDED AS NOT TAKEN: because app/api/feed/music/route.ts:16 uses select('*'), appending these columns changes what that path returns, and at :137-140 the route currently labels EVERY public music track not_recorded / not_requested because the view omits the columns and the || fallback always fires. After this file each track carries its real value. That is a correction of a false negative, but it is a visible trust-label change on a PUBLIC surface and the music/artist lane owns whether the corrected label is what should be shown. The CP-016 regeneration follows the apply and will clear the 4-column viewOnlyColumns delta. Record the staging history disposition here.

required.rationale: HF-DB019-EVENT-PROVIDER-CONNECTIONS. public.event_provider_connections is created by exactly one file in this repository, supabase/migration-archive/pre-reconciliation-local-only-2026-08-20/20260804130000_event_provider_foundation.sql:67-88, whose MANIFEST.csv status is local_only_unapplied, so it existed on no active environment; it is absent from the chain and from lib/database.types.ts, so BOTH barriers are confirmed and regeneration cannot create it. TWO ROUTES ARE REACHABLE AND RETURN 500 ON AN AUTHENTICATED REQUEST TODAY: GET /api/integrations/bandsintown/status has no capability gate at all and reads the relation through the caller own client, and POST /api/integrations/bandsintown/disconnect is gated by session auth only and service-role-WRITEs the caller own row. Neither exposes a credential and neither mutates anything beyond the row the caller already owns. The other three consumers (connect, events/[id]/claim, cron/events/sync) are permanently 503 behind the disabled external_event_providers capability. THE INVENTORY IS WRONG IN BOTH DIRECTIONS AND IS NOT THE CONTRACT SOURCE: it names app/api/hiring/apply/profile-preview/route.ts as a live consumer and that file contains zero references to this relation, while omitting four real consumers, three of which resolve .from() through an untyped service-role client and therefore emit no tsc diagnostic. canonicalReplacement is null, so there is nothing to repoint the five consumers to. THE COLUMN CONTRACT IS TRANSCRIBED BYTE-FOR-BYTE from the archived DDL and every column any consumer selects or writes is present in it, so nothing was invented to make a query resolve; two checks the handoff did not make are made here, namely that connection_mode cannot receive the disabled mode (the connect route early-returns 503) and that no consumer writes secret_reference at all. RLS is enabled AND FORCED with three own-row policies and one service_role arm; authenticated is granted SELECT ONLY, a deliberate narrowing of the archive grant select,insert,update, because the three owner policies constrain created_by and not owner_id and the archived comment records the owning-account check as application-side, so an authenticated INSERT would be an escalation primitive naming any owner_id; anon receives nothing; service_role receives select/insert/update and NOT delete; no DELETE policy exists because no consumer deletes a connection.
